preconditions.expression: isinstance(grid, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in grid) and all(isinstance(cell, int) for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: grid is a list of lists of integers

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(grid) for row in grid)

the cost of each cell is between 1 and 1000
